losses.description: Entity references are treated as a set and sorted for deterministic evidence binding. Native ordering is not preserved unless Polybolos later declares order to be semantic.
Unmapped native details remain outside the neutral candidate. Their top-level names and canonical digest are retained so omission is visible without copying private implementation state.
AXM returns a neutral status projection. It does not claim to reproduce a Polybolos-native status object, operator panel, or internal workflow state.
